system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global forest extent, loss, and gain at 30m resolution covering all land areas from 2000 to 2025, derived from Landsat time-series analysis.

data_description.temporal_coverage: 2000-2025 forest change analysis with year 2000 baseline
data_description.data_format: Google Earth Engine Image asset (single multi-band image)
data_description.temporal_unit: Annual forest loss bands; baseline 2000 tree cover
data_description.records: Single multi-band image containing 25 years of forest change data

treecover2000.description: Tree canopy cover percentage for year 2000 (0-100%)

band_semantics.treecover2000: Baseline tree canopy cover percentage in year 2000
band_semantics.loss: Binary forest loss indicator for 2000-2025 period
band_semantics.lossyear: Year of detected forest loss encoded as 1-25
band_semantics.gain: Forest gain indicator for 2000-2012 subset period

data_description.important_note: This dataset provides the most comprehensive global forest change analysis available. The 'lossyear' band enables year-specific deforestation analysis. Note that 'gain' only covers 2000-2012, while 'loss' covers the full 2000-2025 period.
analytical_capabilities: Global deforestation hotspot identification and quantification
Forest cover baseline assessment for year 2000
Deforestation rate calculation by region and time period
Carbon emission estimation from forest loss
Forest loss correlation with climate, fire, and human activities

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Tree cover: percentage (0-100%); Loss/Gain: binary (0/1); Loss year: year code (1-25 for 2001-2025).
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use 'treecover2000' to filter baseline forest areas (e.g., >30% canopy cover), then analyze 'loss' and 'lossyear' for deforestation patterns.

data_description.reference: Hansen, M. C., P. V. Potapov, R. Moore, M. Hancher, S. A. Turubanova, A. Tyukavina, D. Thau, et al. 2013. High-Resolution Global Maps of 21st-Century Forest Cover Change. Science 342 (15 November): 850-53.
